tagline: Bootstrap production-ready projects in one npx command. Zero install. Multi-language.
repoDescription: Zero-install CLI (npx setupkaro init) that generates complete, production-ready project templates with linting, testing, CI/CD, Docker, and a generated README. Templates: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python FastAPI, Go, Rust, Java Spring, Laravel, PHP, Docker Compose. No telemetry. Extensible via JSON schema.
